{{Top|leg}}
'''Forest-honey''' was found on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Whenever [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] harvested it, he would unwillingly [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] in the process.

Forest-honey was used as a glaze on [[Wookiee flat-biscuit]]s, or with dried seaweed in a stew. It was also used to make [[forest-honey cake]]s.
